task_title: Index baseline observability report: entry count vs tracked specs, delta, agent-path token accounting
task_criteria: A committed docs/observability/ report states the index entry count from node bin/speclang index over the repo's own specs, the count from git ls-files specs/**/*.spec.md, their signed delta, an explicit measured-or-unmeasured token accounting finding with evidence, and the exact commands; counts re-verified live.

items.detail: docs/observability/index-baseline-2026-11-20.md is committed (commit 8cfd7648, tracked per `git ls-files docs/observability/`). All counts re-verified live in this session: `node bin/speclang index` -> 'error: unknown command 'index'' EXIT=1 (report §4.1 documents this failure honestly and gives the working entry point); `node specs/cli.spec.dir/src/index.js index` -> 'Found 493 spec files' / 'Total specs: 485' EXIT=0; `jq '.specs|length' _index.json` = 485; `git ls-files 'specs/**/*.spec.md' | wc -l` = 346; `git ls-files 'specs/*.spec.md' | wc -l` = 468; find over the four spec file classes = 493. Signed deltas stated and arithmetically correct: +139 (485-346) and +147 (493-346), plus +17/+25 against the complete 468-file tracked set with exact reconciliation (2 .scl + 23 .spec - 8 duplicate ids = +17). Duplicate-id claim independently reproduced: 493 per-file header ids -> 485 unique with the same 7 duplicated ids the report lists. Token accounting finding is explicit (UNMEASURED, §3) with 6 evidence points, all spot-verified: `grep -ci token specs/cli.spec.dir/src/commands/index.js` = 0, no token matches in indexer src or specs/sqlite.spec.dir/src/migrations.ts, collateMetrics() at specs/cascade.spec.dir/src/coordinator/index.ts:616 only attached when --metrics passed (line 463), docs/observability-spec.md:71 confirms 'printed, never stored'. Exact commands with verbatim output in §4 and reproduction steps in §7.

tool_calls.command: git ls-files 'specs/**/*.spec.md' | wc -l; git ls-files 'specs/*.spec.md' | wc -l; git ls-files specs | grep -c '\.spec\.md$'
jq '.specs|length' _index.json; git checkout -- _index.json 2>&1; git status --porcelain | head

grep -ci token specs/cli.spec.dir/src/commands/index.js; grep -rni token specs/indexer.spec.dir/src src/cli/commands/index.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; grep -rni token specs/sqlite.spec.dir/src/migrations.ts | head

grep -n 'collateMetrics\|input_tokens\|output_tokens' specs/cascade.spec.dir/src/coordinator/index.ts | head; echo "---"; sed -n '95,115p' specs/cli.spec.dir/src/utils.ts; echo "---"; grep -n 'token' docs/observability-spec.md | head -8

grep -c 'id: "' specs/*.spec.md specs/**/*.spec.md 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '{s+=$NF} END {print s}'; grep -h '^id: ' $(find specs -name '*.spec.md' -o -name '*.scl' -o -name '*.spec' | head -1000) 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -d | head

grep -h '^id: ' $(find specs -type f \( -name '*.spec.md' -o -name '*.scl' -o -name '*.spec' \)) | sort > /tmp/obs6-verify-ids.txt; wc -l < /tmp/obs6-verify-ids.txt; sort -u /tmp/obs6-verify-ids.txt | wc -l; uniq -d /tmp/obs6-verify-ids.txt

for f in $(find specs -type f \( -name '*.spec.md' -o -name '*.scl' -o -name '*.spec' \)); do head -20 "$f" | grep -m1 '^id: '; done | sort > /tmp/obs6-hdr.txt; wc -l < /tmp/obs6-hdr.txt; sort -u /tmp/obs6-hdr.txt | wc -l; uniq -d /tmp/obs6-hdr.txt
